title: Incandescent
subtitle: Light, flight, brilliance
text: Incandescent tendency is radiant intensity: light, elevation, and spectacle. Blood flooded with radiance becomes outward-facing and expansive. It does not contain itself. It reaches. Incandescent-tended Hemomancers are often difficult to predict — their blood pulls them toward breadth rather than depth, and they tend to affect everything around them before they affect themselves.
